gate_conditions.condition_description: TransportCpuBaselineImplementationPlan.v1 must be present and sealed with all 7 algorithm steps and 6 numerical stability entries covering LP topology declaration, degenerate path topology, balance check, and all NOT_COMPUTABLE branches.

TransportCpuBaselineValidationPlan.v1 must be present and sealed covering all 6 valid fixtures, 4 invalid fixture rejections, 5 not-computable fixture rejections, declared balance tolerance policy, and no-LP-solver scan.
TransportDistanceImplementationReadinessDossier.v1 must be present and sealed with TRANSPORT_READINESS_DOSSIER_DEFINED status.
All governance_flags in both plan artifacts must be false; no authority lock may be elevated; lp_solver_invoked and transport_computation_added must remain false.

Operator explicit authorization instruction required before any implementation PR may be opened. LP solver variant, pivot rule, tie-breaking strategy, and balance tolerance must be finalized as locked constants before implementation. This review does not constitute authorization.

stop_boundary_reason: Operator authorization required before any implementation PR may be opened. LP solver variant, pivot rule, tie-breaking strategy, and balance tolerance must be finalized as locked constants. This gate review is advisory-only. gate-cond-005 is not met.
